air_of_a_comeback.text_zh: 你可以将你坟场中的一张非攻击行动牌置于你的牌库顶。若你手牌中没有牌，改为将其置入你的手牌。
air_of_a_comeback.text_en: You may put a non-attack action card from your graveyard on top of your deck. If you have no cards in hand, instead you may play it this turn from your graveyard without paying its {r} cost.

alluring_inducement__2.text_zh:
希亚娜专精
当此牌攻击时，防御英雄展示其手牌。你可以选择一张以此方式展示的攻击行动牌。若如此做，此牌成为所选牌。
团结——当此牌与一张来自手牌的牌一起防御时，在任意数量英雄的控制下创造一个雄辩衍生物。
alluring_inducement__2.text_en:
Shiyana Specialization
When this attacks, the defending hero reveals their hand. You may choose an attack action card revealed this way. If you do, this becomes the chosen card.
Unity - When this defends together with a card from hand, create an Eloquence token under any number of heroes' control.

arena_medic.text_zh:
获得1点生命。
若你手牌中没有牌，改为获得3点生命。
arena_medic.text_en:
Gain 1{h}.
If you have no cards in hand, instead gain 3{h}.

art_of_war__2.text_zh:
选择2个；
本回合你控制的攻击行动牌获得+1力量和+1防御。
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得再动。
直到回合结束，你可以用军械库中的攻击行动牌防御。
你可以放逐你手牌中的一张攻击行动牌。若如此做，抽2张牌。
art_of_war__2.text_en:
Choose 2;

Attack action cards you control gain +1{p} and +1{d} this turn.
The next attack action card you play this turn gains go again.
Until end of turn, you may defend with attack action cards from arsenal.
You may banish an attack action card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

awakening__3.text_zh:
大地融合
若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，创造与你与对手生命差等量的地震涌动衍生物。若觉醒已融合，改为创造两倍数量的地震涌动衍生物。
从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用小于或等于你控制的地震涌动衍生物数量的守护者攻击行动牌，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
awakening__3.text_en:
Earth Fusion
If you have less {h} than an opposing hero, create Seismic Surge tokens equal to the difference. If Awakening was fused, instead create twice that many Seismic Surge tokens.
Search your deck for a Guardian attack action card with cost less than or equal to the number of Seismic Surge tokens you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

ball_lightning__1.text_zh:
本战斗链中每当闪电或元素行动牌将造成伤害时，改为它造成等量加1的伤害。
再动
ball_lightning__1.text_en:
Whenever a Lightning or Elemental action card would deal damage this combat chain, instead it deals that much damage plus 1.
Go again

ball_lightning__2.text_zh:
本战斗链中每当闪电或元素行动牌将造成伤害时，改为它造成等量加1的伤害。
再动

Whenever a Lightning or Elemental action card would deal damage this combat chain, instead it deals that much damage plus 1.

再动
ball_lightning__3.text_en:
Whenever a Lightning or Elemental action card would deal damage this combat chain, instead it deals that much damage plus 1.
Go again

belittle__1.text_zh: 作为使用轻视的额外费用，你可以展示你手牌中一张基础力量为3或更低的攻击行动牌。若如此做，此牌获得+3力量。
belittle__1.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Belittle, you may reveal an attack action card with 3 or less base {p} from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card named Minnowism, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.
Go again

belittle__2.text_zh: 作为使用轻视的额外费用，你可以展示你手牌中一张基础力量为3或更低的攻击行动牌。若如此做，此牌获得+3力量。
belittle__2.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Belittle, you may reveal an attack action card with 3 or less base {p} from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card named Minnowism, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.
Go again

belittle__3.text_zh: 作为使用轻视的额外费用，你可以展示你手牌中一张基础力量为3或更低的攻击行动牌。若如此做，此牌获得+3力量。
belittle__3.text_en:

Go again

benefactor_of_bloodworth_goldmane.text_zh:
创造一个金币衍生物。
你本回合的下一次攻击获得“当此牌攻击时，它获得+X力量，X为你控制的金币数量。”
benefactor_of_bloodworth_goldmane.text_en:
Create a Gold token.
Your next attack this turn gets "When this attacks, it gets +X{p}, where X is the number of Gold you control."

berserk__2.text_zh:
直到回合结束，每当你随机弃置一张力量为6或更高的牌时，放逐它。若如此做，展示你牌库顶的3张牌。你可以使用一张以此方式展示且力量为6或更高的牌。
再动
berserk__2.text_en:
Until end of turn, whenever you discard a random card with 6 or more {p}, banish it. If you do, reveal the top card of your deck. If it has 6 or more {p}, draw a card.
Go again

big_hits_big_applause.text_zh:
直到回合结束，每当一位英雄赢得交锋时，该英雄抽一张牌。
与每位对手英雄交锋。
big_hits_big_applause.text_en:
Until end of turn, whenever a hero wins a clash, they draw a card.
Clash with each opposing hero.

bloodied_boots.text_zh:
你可以装备此牌。
行动——摧毁此牌：获得2个行动点。
bloodied_boots.text_en:
You may equip this.
Action - Destroy this: Gain 2 action points.

bloodied_gauntlet.text_zh:
你可以装备此牌。
行动——摧毁此牌：本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+2力量。再动
bloodied_gauntlet.text_en:
You may equip this.
Action - Destroy this: The next attack action card you play this turn gets +2{p}. Go again

bloodied_helm.text_zh:
你可以装备此牌。
瞬间——摧毁此牌：将你军械库中的一张牌置于你的牌库底。
bloodied_helm.text_en:
You may equip this.
Instant - Destroy this: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card.

bloodied_shield.text_zh:
你可以装备此牌。
刃碎
bloodied_shield.text_en:
You may equip this.
Blade Break

bloodied_strapping.text_zh:
你可以装备此牌。
行动——摧毁此牌：本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌使用费用减少1点资源。再动
bloodied_strapping.text_en:
You may equip this.
Action - Destroy this: The next attack action card you play this turn costs {r}{r} less to play. Go again

bloodsheath_skeleta.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌和非攻击行动牌获得再动。
bloodsheath_skeleta.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: The next attack action card and non-attack action card you play this turn get "This card costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control."
Temper

bonds_of_agony__3.text_zh:
隐匿
若此链环中你使用或启动过3张或更多攻击反应，此牌获得+3力量，以及"当此牌命中英雄时，查看其手牌并选择一张牌。搜寻其手牌、牌库和坟场，并放逐至多3张与所选牌同名的牌。该英雄洗牌。"
bonds_of_agony__3.text_en:
Stealth
If you've played or activated 3 or more attack reactions this chain link, this gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card. Search their hand, deck, and graveyard and banish up to 3 cards with the same name as the chosen card. They shuffle."

brand_with_cinderclaw__1.text_zh:
本战斗链中你的下一次攻击除其原有类别外还视为龙裔。
再动
brand_with_cinderclaw__1.text_en:
Your next attack this combat chain is Draconic in addition to its other card types.
Go again

brand_with_cinderclaw__2.text_zh:
本战斗链中你的下一次攻击除其原有类别外还视为龙裔。
再动
brand_with_cinderclaw__2.text_en:
Your next attack this combat chain is Draconic in addition to its other card types.
Go again

brand_with_cinderclaw__3.text_zh:

再动
brand_with_cinderclaw__3.text_en:
Your next attack this combat chain is Draconic in addition to its other card types.
Go again

brush_of_heavenly_rites.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：从你的物品栏装备一件名称中含有宣言的副手。再动
brush_of_heavenly_rites.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Equip an off-hand with Proclamation in its name from your inventory. Go again

cash_in__2.text_zh:
你可以摧毁你控制的4个铜币、2个银币或1个金币，而非支付兑现的费用。
抽2张牌。
再动
cash_in__2.text_en:
You may destroy 4 Coppers, 2 Silvers, or 1 Gold you control rather than pay Cash In's {r} cost.
Draw 2 cards.
Go again

channel_lightning_valley__2.text_zh:
你每回合第一次对对手英雄造成伤害时，抽一张牌。
引导闪电——在你的结束阶段开始时，在此牌上放置一个流动指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个流动指示物将一张闪电牌从资源区置于牌库底，否则摧毁此牌。
channel_lightning_valley__2.text_en:
The first time you deal damage to an opposing hero each turn, draw a card.
Channel Lightning - At the beginning of your end phase, put a flow counter on this, then destroy it unless you put a Lightning card from your pitch zone on the bottom of your deck for each flow counter on it.

chart_the_high_seas__3.text_zh:
查看你牌库顶的2张牌。你可以从其中资源一张蓝色牌。将其余牌置入你的坟场。
每有一张以此方式置入你的坟场的黄色牌，创造一个金币衍生物。
再动
chart_the_high_seas__3.text_en:
Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may pitch a blue card from among them. Put the rest into your graveyard.
Create a Gold token for each yellow card put into your graveyard this way.
Go again

chief_rukutan.text_zh:
当鲁库坦牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将他翻为正面朝上。
当鲁库坦正面朝上在军械库中时，每当你使用一张力量为6或更高的牌时，威吓，并在其上放置一个课业指示物。然后若鲁库坦上有2个或更多课业指示物，放逐他，从你的牌库中搜寻阿尔法狂暴，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
chief_rukutan.text_en:
While Ruk'utan is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn him face up.
While Ruk'utan is face up in arsenal, whenever you play a card with 6 or more {p}, intimidate, and put a lesson counter on him. Then if there are 2 or more lesson counters on Ruk'utan, banish him, search your deck for Alpha Rampage, put it face up in arsenal, and shuffle.

code_of_conduct_kill_or_be_killed.name_en: Code of Conduct: Kill or Be Killed
code_of_conduct_kill_or_be_killed.text_zh: 直到回合结束，你可以攻击任意对手英雄，且当你对其造成致命伤害时，在此回合之后额外进行一个回合。
code_of_conduct_kill_or_be_killed.text_en: Until end of turn, you may attack any opposing hero and when you deal lethal damage to them, take an extra turn after this one.

count_your_blessings__1.text_zh: 获得X点生命，X为3加上你坟场中数算你的祝福的数量。
count_your_blessings__1.text_en: Gain X{h}, where X is 3 plus the number of Count Your Blessings in your graveyard.

count_your_blessings__2.text_zh: 获得X点生命，X为3加上你坟场中数算你的祝福的数量。
count_your_blessings__2.text_en: Gain X{h}, where X is 2 plus the number of Count Your Blessings in your graveyard.

count_your_blessings__3.text_zh: 获得X点生命，X为3加上你坟场中数算你的祝福的数量。
count_your_blessings__3.text_en: Gain X{h}, where X is 1 plus the number of Count Your Blessings in your graveyard.

cracker_bauble__2.text_zh: 当此牌被资源时，你与目标对手随机选择此牌的两端并拉扯直到此牌断成两半。然后每位英雄创造其那一半背面的衍生物，此牌不再存在。
cracker_bauble__2.text_en: When this is pitched, you and target opponent randomly choose opposite ends of this and pull them until this breaks in half. Then each hero creates the token on the back of their half, and this ceases to exist.

crowd_roars_fight.text_zh: 你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量，且可以攻击任意对手英雄。
crowd_roars_fight.text_en: Your next attack this turn gets +1{p} and may attack any opposing hero.

crown_of_seeds.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源，将你军械库中的一张牌面朝下的牌置于你的牌库底：抽一张牌，并防止本回合接下来将对你的英雄造成的1点伤害。
crown_of_seeds.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}, put a face down card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck: Draw a card and prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn.

crushing_impact.text_zh: 本回合你下一次将造成少于4点伤害时，改为造成4点伤害。
crushing_impact.text_en: The next time you would deal less than 4 damage this turn, instead deal 4 damage.

diamond_hands.text_zh:
鲁迪专精
在你的结束阶段开始时，若你手牌中有4张或更多牌，创造一个钻石衍生物。
刃碎
diamond_hands.text_en:
Ruu'di Specialization
At the beginning of your end phase, if you have 4 or more cards in hand, create a Diamond token.
Blade Break

didnt_see_that_coming.text_zh: 每位生命高于你的英雄弃一张牌。
didnt_see_that_coming.text_en: Each hero who has more {h} than you discards a card.

dominate_the_competition.text_zh: 你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
dominate_the_competition.text_en: Your next attack this turn gets dominate.

dragons_of_legend.text_zh:

泰迈 - 1资源, 2费用, 3防御
文塞拉凯 - 1资源, 3费用, 3防御
延杜莱 - 1资源, 1费用, 3防御
你可以将此牌放入你的牌库以替代你拥有的一张召龙。勾选此牌所召唤龙名旁边的方框。当此牌被使用或置入你的坟场时，将其替换为被召龙的牌。
dragons_of_legend.text_en:
Dracona Optimai - 1 pitch, 6 cost, 3 block
Tomeltai - 1 pitch, 5 cost, 3 block
Dominia - 1 pitch, 4 cost, 3 block
Azvolai - 1 pitch, 0 cost, 3 block

drone_of_brutality__1.text_zh: 若暴行嗡鸣将从任何区域置入你的坟场，改为将其置于你的牌库底。
drone_of_brutality__1.text_en: If Drone of Brutality would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, instead put it on the bottom of your deck.

drone_of_brutality__2.text_zh: 若暴行嗡鸣将从任何区域置入你的坟场，改为将其置于你的牌库底。
drone_of_brutality__2.text_en: If Drone of Brutality would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, instead put it on the bottom of your deck.

drone_of_brutality__3.text_zh: 若暴行嗡鸣将从任何区域置入你的坟场，改为将其置于你的牌库底。
drone_of_brutality__3.text_en: If Drone of Brutality would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, instead put it on the bottom of your deck.

duskblade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
每当你用暮刃攻击时，若本回合你使用过一张攻击行动牌和一张"非攻击"行动牌，在暮刃上放置一个+1力量指示物。
在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合你尚未使用攻击行动牌和"非攻击"行动牌，从暮刃上移除所有+1力量指示物。
duskblade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
Whenever you attack with Duskblade, if you've played an attack action card and a 'non-attack' action card this turn, put a +1{p} counter on Duskblade.
At the beginning of your end phase, if you haven't played an attack action card and a 'non-attack' action card this turn, remove all +1{p} counters from Duskblade.

embody_greatness__2.text_zh:
希亚娜专精
说出一位在世传奇英雄的名字。直到你的下一个回合开始，你成为该英雄，但你的基础生命不变。
embody_greatness__2.text_en:
Shiyana Specialization
Name a living legend hero. Become that hero until the start of your next turn, except your base {h} doesn't change.

ez_sqeez_bookie_syndicate.text_zh: 直到回合结束，每当你攻击英雄时，与该英雄下注。胜者创造2个金币衍生物。
ez_sqeez_bookie_syndicate.text_en: Until end of turn, whenever you attack a hero, wager with them. The winner creates 2 Gold tokens.

fabric_of_blossoms__3.text_zh: 装备春华。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_blossoms__3.text_en: Equip Blossom of Spring. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_hope__1.text_zh: 装备希望商贩兜帽。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_hope__1.text_en: Equip Hope Merchant's Hood. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_providence__1.text_zh:
传奇
装备天佑之冠。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_providence__1.text_en:
Legendary
Equip Crown of Providence. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_scales__3.text_zh: 装备金鱼草鳞甲。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_scales__3.text_en: Equip Snapdragon Scalers. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_spring__2.text_zh: 装备菲恩达尔的春日外衣。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_spring__2.text_en: Equip Fyendal's Spring Tunic. If you don't, negate this.

fight_night_prize_purse.text_zh: 选择一位对手。你与该对手各创造一个金币衍生物。
fight_night_prize_purse.text_en: Choose an opponent. You each create a Gold token.

gate_to_iarathael.text_zh: 瞬间——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：本回合你可以从你的放逐区使用目标具有血债的行动牌。
gate_to_iarathael.text_en: Instant - {r}, destroy this: You may play target action card with blood debt from your banished zone this turn.

gavel_of_natural_order.text_zh:
与副手配对
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
每当对手每回合使用或启动其第一张牌或异能时，若非其回合，在此牌上放置一个+1力量指示物。在你的结束阶段开始时，从此牌上移除所有+1力量指示物。
gavel_of_natural_order.text_en:
Pairs with an off-hand
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
Whenever an opponent plays or activates their first card or ability each turn, if it's not their turn, put a +1{p} counter on this. At the beginning of your end phase, remove all +1{p} counters from this.

go_bananas__2.text_zh: 说出一张行动牌名。拆开并展示一包Flesh and Blood补充包，将所有具有所选名称的牌置入你的手牌。若补充包中没有具有所选名称的牌，你可以重复此过程。
go_bananas__2.text_en: Name an action card. Open and reveal a booster pack of Flesh and Blood and put all cards with the chosen name into your hand. If the booster pack does not contain a card with the chosen name, you may repeat this process.

good_deeds_dont_go_unnoticed__2.text_zh:
在每位其他英雄的回合开始时，选择其一；该英雄抽一张牌，该英雄获得1点资源，该英雄获得1点生命，或该英雄本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌。若另一位英雄因此牌抽过牌，你抽一张牌，然后对资源、生命和力量各重复一次。
good_deeds_dont_go_unnoticed__2.text_en:
At the start of each other hero's turn, choose 1; they draw a card, they gain {r}, they gain 1{h}, or their next attack this turn gains +1{p}.
At the start of your turn, destroy this. If another hero drew a card from this, you draw a card, then repeat for {r}, {h}, and {p}.

hala_goldenhelm.text_zh:
当哈拉牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将她翻为正面朝上。
当哈拉正面朝上在军械库中时，每当你控制的剑攻击命中时，它获得再动，并在哈拉上放置一个课业指示物。然后若哈拉上有2个或更多课业指示物，放逐她，从你的牌库中搜寻闪耀钢刃，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
hala_goldenhelm.text_en:
While Hala is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn her face up.
While Hala is face up in arsenal, whenever a sword attack you control hits, it gains go again and put a lesson counter on Hala. Then if there are 2 or more lesson counters on Hala, banish her, search your deck for Glistening Steelblade, put it face up in arsenal, and shuffle.

high_octane__1.text_zh:
本回合每当你推进一张牌时，获得1个行动点。
抽一张牌。
再动
high_octane__1.text_en:
Whenever you boost a card this turn, gain 1 action point.
Draw a card.
Go again

hit_the_jackpot.text_zh:
创造一个金币衍生物。
抽与你控制的金币总数等量的牌。
hit_the_jackpot.text_en:
Create a Gold token.
Draw cards equal to the total Gold you control.

hummingbird_call_of_adventure.text_zh:
在你的回合开始时，选择其一；
- 每位英雄创造一个加速衍生物。
- 每位英雄抽一张牌。
- 每位英雄获得1点生命。
hummingbird_call_of_adventure.text_en:
At the start of your turn, choose 1;
- Each hero creates a Quicken token.
- Each hero draws a card.
- Each hero gains 1{h}.

intellect_penalty.text_zh:
你的英雄获得-1智力。
若你将创造一个带有X个指示物的智力惩罚，改为在此牌上增加X个回合指示物。
若你将在回合结束时抽牌至英雄智力值，改为抽等量的牌，从此牌上移除一个回合指示物。若此牌上没有回合指示物，将其移出游戏。
intellect_penalty.text_en:
Your hero has -1{i}.
If you would create an Intellect Penalty with X counters on it, instead add X turn counters onto this.
If you would draw up to your hero's intellect as an end-of-turn procedure, instead draw that many cards, remove a turn counter from this, and remove it from the game if it has no turn counters on it.

ire_of_the_crowd.text_zh: 在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合你没有命中英雄，失去2点生命。
ire_of_the_crowd.text_en: At the beginning of your end phase, if you didn't hit a hero this turn, lose 2{h}.

lady_barthimont.text_zh:
当巴希蒙特牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将她翻为正面朝上。
当巴希蒙特正面朝上在军械库中时，每当你使用攻击行动牌时，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。若被放逐的牌力量为6或更高，该攻击获得支配，并在巴希蒙特上放置一个课业指示物。然后若她上有2个或更多课业指示物，放逐她，从你的牌库中搜寻一张专精牌，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
lady_barthimont.text_en:
While Barthimont is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn her face up.
While Barthimont is face up in arsenal, whenever you play an attack action card, banish the top card of your deck. If the banished card has 6 or more {p}, the attack gains dominate and put a lesson counter on Barthimont. Then if there are 2 or more lesson counters on her, banish her, search your deck for a specialization card, put it face up into arsenal, and shuffle.

let_me_buy_you_a_drink.name_en: Let Me Buy You a Drink
let_me_buy_you_a_drink.text_zh:
摧毁你控制的一个金币。
选择一位对手。该英雄抽一张牌。直到你的下一个回合开始，该英雄控制的以你为目标的攻击获得-2力量。
let_me_buy_you_a_drink.text_en:
Destroy a Gold you control.
Choose an opponent. They draw a card. Until the start of your next turn, attacks they control that target you get -2{p}.

lord_sutcliffe.text_zh:
当萨特克利夫牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将他翻为正面朝上。
当萨特克利夫正面朝上在军械库中时，每当你使用"非攻击"行动牌时，对每位英雄造成1点秘法伤害，并每以此方式造成1点伤害在萨特克利夫上放置一个课业指示物。然后若其上有3个或更多课业指示物，放逐他，从你的牌库中搜寻一张专精牌，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
lord_sutcliffe.text_en:
While Sutcliffe is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn him face up.
While Sutcliffe is face up in arsenal, whenever you play a 'non-attack' action card, deal 1 arcane damage to each hero and put a lesson counter on Sutcliffe for each damage dealt this way. Then if there are 3 or more lesson counters on him, banish him, search your deck for a specialization card, put it face up into arsenal, and shuffle.

magrar.text_zh:
杰尼斯专精
行动——摧毁此牌：创造一个禅定和一个惰性衍生物。
magrar.text_en:
Genis Specialization
Action - Destroy this: Create a Zen State and an Inertia token.

marked.text_zh: 你处于被标记状态，直到一位对手命中你。
marked.text_en: You are marked until an opponent hits you

minerva_themis.text_zh:
当米涅娃牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将她翻为正面朝上。
当米涅娃正面朝上在军械库中时，你控制的单手武器获得+1力量。每当你控制的武器命中时，在米涅娃上放置一个课业指示物。然后若其上有3个或更多课业指示物，放逐她，从你的牌库中搜寻一张专精牌，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
minerva_themis.text_en:
While Minerva is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn her face up.
While Minerva is face up in arsenal, 1H weapons you control have +1{p}. Whenever a weapon you control hits, put a lesson counter on Minerva. Then if there are 3 or more lesson counters on her, banish her, search your deck for a specialization card, put it face up into arsenal, and shuffle.

off_cuts__3.text_zh:
弗兰基专精
每位英雄摧毁其控制的一件装备。
再动

Frankie Specialization
Each hero destroys an equipment they control.
Go again

omens_of_arcana.text_zh:

闪电流转衍生物获得法力虚空1。

Each hero starts the game with a Lightning Flow token.
Lightning Flow tokens get spellvoid 1.

传奇
抽2张牌。若为使用此牌资源过一张气，改为抽3张牌。

Legendary
Draw 2 cards. If a Chi was pitched to play this, instead draw 3 cards.

每当你控制的幻术师牌被摧毁时，在此牌上放置一个+1力量指示物。
虚击
结界1
phantom_tidemaw__3.text_en:
Whenever an Illusionist card you control is destroyed, put a +1{p} counter on this.
Phantasm
Ward 1

pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.name_en: Pick Yourself Up Off the Floor
pick_yourself_up_off_the_floor.text_zh: 将你坟场中的一张攻击行动牌置于你的牌库顶。若你的生命低于一位对手，改为将其置入你的手牌。

Once per Turn Action - {r}: The next card you reveal this turn has its grade increased by 1. Go again

plume_of_evergrowth.text_zh: 瞬间——支付3点资源，摧毁长青之羽：将你坟场中的目标大地行动牌或大地瞬间牌移回你的手牌。
plume_of_evergrowth.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}{r}, destroy Plume of Evergrowth: Return target Earth action card or Earth instant card from your graveyard to your hand.

本回合你控制的攻击行动牌下一次命中时，抽一张牌。

再动

proclamation_of_combat.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Until the start of your next turn, the only actions heroes may play or activate are weapon and attack actions.

proclamation_of_production.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：每位英雄可以从其牌库中搜寻一张费用为0或1的物品，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。每位没有以此方式将物品放入竞技场的英雄弃一张牌。
proclamation_of_production.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Each hero may search their deck for an item with cost 0 or 1, put it into the arena, then shuffle. Each hero who doesn't put an item into the arena this way discards a card.

proclamation_of_requisition.text_zh: 行动——弃一张红色牌，摧毁征用宣言：每位对手选择其控制的一个物品或地标。获得所选永久物的控制权。
proclamation_of_requisition.text_en: Action - Discard a red card, destroy Proclamation of Requisition: Each opponent chooses an item or landmark they control. Gain control of the chosen permanents.

rally_the_underdog.text_zh: 抽一张牌。若你的生命低于一位对手，改为抽2张牌。
rally_the_underdog.text_en: Draw a card. If you have less {h} than an opponent, instead draw 2 cards.

random_events_unfold.text_zh: 洗事件牌库，将此牌置于牌库底，然后翻开最顶上一张。
random_events_unfold.text_en: Shuffle the event deck, put this on the bottom, then flip the top card.

reaping_blade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
若一位英雄的生命高于其他所有英雄，该英雄不能获得生命。
reaping_blade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
If a hero has more {h} than any other hero, they can't gain {h}.

remembrance__2.text_zh:
将你坟场中的至多3张行动牌洗入你的牌库。
放逐追忆。
remembrance__2.text_en:
Shuffle up to 3 action cards from your graveyard into your deck.
Banish Remembrance.

riches_of_tropal_dhani__2.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌被资源时，创造一个金币衍生物。
riches_of_tropal_dhani__2.text_en:
Legendary
When this is pitched, create a Gold token.

sanctuary_of_aria.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源：防止本回合接下来将由你选择的一个来源对你造成的1点伤害。在结束阶段开始时摧毁此牌。
sanctuary_of_aria.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn by a source of your choice. Destroy this at the beginning of the end phase.

scarf_for_a_scarf__1.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，与该英雄交换一件头部装备永久物。若如此做，此牌获得再动。
scarf_for_a_scarf__1.text_en: When this attacks a hero, exchange a head equipment permanent with them. If you do, this gets go again.

shitty_xmas_present__2.text_zh: 将一张来自游戏外的破裂饰物置于目标英雄的牌库顶。
shitty_xmas_present__2.text_en: Put a Cracked Bauble from outside the game on top of target hero's deck.

silversheen_needle.text_zh: 你拥有的名称中含有织品的构组获得再动。
silversheen_needle.text_en: Your constructs with Fabric in their name gain go again.

spirit_of_christmas__3.text_zh:
每位英雄选择另一位英雄。被选英雄创造一个敏捷、力量、活力和金币衍生物。
再动
spirit_of_christmas__3.text_en:
Each hero chooses another hero. The chosen hero creates an Agility, Might, Vigor, and Gold token.
Go again

sticky_fingers.text_zh:

Perched

stubby_hammerers.text_en: Action - Destroy Stubby Hammerers: Attack action cards with 3 or less base power gain +1{p} while attacking this turn. Go again

tales_of_adventure__3.text_zh:
约里克专精
每位其他英雄选择并创造一个尚未被选择的衍生物；以太灰翼、大地化身、闪电化身、沉思、加速、符文吟唱、地震涌动、灵魂枷锁、幻质护盾、禅定。
你创造一个铜币、银币和金币。
tales_of_adventure__3.text_en:
Yorick Specialization
Each other hero chooses and creates a token that hasn't been chosen; Aether Ashwing, Embodiment of Earth, Embodiment of Lightning, Ponder, Quicken, Runechant, Seismic Surge, Soul Shackle, Spectral Shield, Zen State.
You create a Copper, Silver, and Gold.

the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.name_en: The Hand that Pulls the Strings
the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——费用0：将此牌翻为正面朝上。仅当此牌在你军械库中牌面朝下时才能启动此异能。
当此牌正面朝上在军械库中时，你每回合第一次具有契约的攻击获得再动。若它正在攻击皇族英雄，它获得+1力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁你控制的一个银币。若你没有，将此牌置于你的牌库底并抽一张牌。
the_hand_that_pulls_the_strings.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - 0: Turn this face-up. Activate this only while this is face-down in your arsenal.
While this is face-up in arsenal, your first attack with contract each turn gets go again. If it's attacking a Royal hero, it gets +1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy a Silver you control. If you don't, put this on the bottom of your deck and draw a card.

the_librarian.text_zh:
当图书管理员牌面朝下在军械库中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以将他翻为正面朝上。
当图书管理员正面朝上在军械库中时，每回合一次，当你创造幻质护盾衍生物时，抽一张牌，并在图书管理员上放置一个课业指示物。然后若其上有3个或更多课业指示物，放逐他，从你的牌库中搜寻一张专精牌，将其正面朝上放入军械库，然后洗牌。
the_librarian.text_en:
While The Librarian is face down in arsenal, at the start of your turn, you may turn him face up.
While The Librarian is face up in arsenal, once per turn when you create a Spectral Shield token, draw a card and put a lesson counter on The Librarian. Then if there are 3 or more lesson counters on him, banish him, search your deck for a specialization card, put it face up into arsenal, and shuffle.

the_moat_exchange.text_zh: 每位英雄可以将其手牌或军械库中的任意数量牌置于其牌库底，然后为此方式置于牌库底的每张牌抽一张牌。
the_moat_exchange.text_en: Each hero may put any number of cards from their hand or arsenal on the bottom of their deck, then they draw a card for each card they put on the bottom this way.

tome_of_aetherwind__1.text_zh:

本回合你使用的下一张具有造成秘法伤害效果的牌改为造成等量加1的秘法伤害。
抽一张牌。

tome_of_divinity__2.text_en:
Draw 2 cards.
If a card has been put into your hero's soul this turn, instead draw 3 cards.

tome_of_firebrand__1.text_zh:
仅当你控制4个或更多龙裔链环时才能使用火种之书。
抽2张牌。
tome_of_firebrand__1.text_en:
Play Tome of Firebrand only if you control 4 or more Draconic chain links.
Draw 2 cards.

tome_of_fyendal__2.text_zh:
抽2张牌。
若菲恩达尔之书是从军械库使用的，为你手牌中的每张牌获得1点生命。
tome_of_fyendal__2.text_en:
Draw 2 cards.
If Tome of Fyendal is played from arsenal, gain 1{h} for each card in your hand.

treasure_island.text_zh:
每回合第一次英雄被攻击时，在此牌上放置一个金币指示物。
每当你或你控制的盟友对对手英雄造成伤害时，你从此牌上移除等量的金币指示物，然后创造与此方式移除的指示物数量相等的金币衍生物。
treasure_island.text_en:
The first time a hero is attacked each turn, put a gold counter on this.
Whenever you or an ally you control deals damage to an opposing hero, you remove that many gold counters from this, then create Gold tokens equal to the number of counters removed this way.

tremor_of_anticipation.text_zh:
直到回合结束，若任意英雄将创造1个或更多衍生物，改为其创造数量加1的每种这些衍生物。
创造一个金币衍生物。
tremor_of_anticipation.text_en:
Until end of turn, if any hero would create 1 or more tokens, instead they create that many plus 1 of each of those tokens.
Create a Gold token.

tremor_of_iarathael__1.text_en: If a card has been put into your banished zone this turn, Tremor of íArathael gains +2{p}.
